item.title: Legend Biotech CAR-T
item.description:
• Summary: At the EHA 2026 congress, Legend Biotech presented promising early data for its in vivo CAR-T candidate LB2501 in lymphoma. The therapy, designed to generate CAR-T cells directly in the body, demonstrated a best-in-class safety and efficacy profile, driving significant stock gains and positioning Legend as a rare market winner in a crowded field.
  • MoAs: In vivo CAR-T: Uses a vector to program a patient's own T cells to express a chimeric antigen receptor targeting tumor antigens (e.g., CD19) without ex vivo manipulation.
  • Sources: ApexOnco, BioPharma Dive, STAT News, BioSpace

item.title: Roche Giredestrant FDA Priority Review
item.description:
• Summary: Roche's experimental oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) giredestrant has been granted FDA priority review for the treatment of estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer. The designation accelerates the review timeline, with a decision expected later this year.
  • MoAs: Selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
